title: ELEET: Efficient Learned Query Execution over Text and Tables
caption: Figure 2: Overview of ELEET. In an offline phase, the ELEET-model can be fine-tuned for unseen domains 1○. Fine-tuning the ELEET-model for an unseen domain is a one-time effort and requires a small sample of a few labeled texts. 2○For query execution, ELEET uses multi-modal query plans that contain traditional (white) and multi-modal database operators (purple). To compute the result of a multi-modal operation such as a join over texts, the ELEET-model is used (see a○to c○): During the execution of a multi-modal operation, the ELEET model first computes embeddings of the query attributes, texts, and table input
